props.name: containerRef
props.description: The positioned element both endpoints live inside.

props.name: fromRef
props.description: The element the beam starts at.

props.name: toRef
props.description: The element the beam ends at.

props.name: curvature
props.description: Bow of the curve in pixels. Negative bows the other way. 0 is a straight line.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Send the pulse from `to` to `from` instead.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one pulse to cross.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the first pulse. Stagger these across a diagram.

props.name: pathColor
props.description: The dim track the pulse runs along.

props.name: pathWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the dim track underneath.

props.name: pathOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the dim track underneath.

props.name: beamColor
props.description: Any CSS colour for the travelling pulse.

props.name: beamLength
props.description: Length of the lit pulse in pixels.

props.name: paused
props.description: Draw the track but hold the pulse still.
